main.title: A Rather Peculiar Welcome
main.detail: Find Mayor Honk by the cottage and introduce yourself.
main.quote: Welcome! I was elected unanimously. I was the only candidate. And the only voter.

main.title: Some Assembly Encouraged
main.detail: Gather timber and stone, then place a workbench.
main.quote: Our previous craftsman was a beaver. Excellent work. Ate the invoice.

main.title: Lettuce Begin
main.detail: Plant seeds, water the beds, and harvest at least three carrots.
main.quote: Talk to your plants. I usually discuss local zoning.

main.title: A Toast to Civilization
main.detail: Use a campfire to bake one loaf of carrot bread.
main.quote: Bread is just a sandwich waiting for purpose.

main.title: Home, Sweet Slightly Crooked Home
main.detail: Raise a cottage on the homestead. A roof is strongly recommended during weather.
main.quote: The property market is wild. Yesterday a mushroom sold for three acorns.

main.title: The Light at the End of the Honk
main.detail: Recover the sun crystal from the Forgotten Garden ruins at (-6, -18). Bring it with 3 planks and 5 stone to the lighthouse at (17, -9), then press E. This completes the opening act and begins the wider island adventure.
main.quote: I borrowed the lighthouse bulb for my reading lamp. In retrospect, a maritime incident.

main.title: A Ranger Arrangement
main.detail: Follow the western trail into Whisperwood and meet ranger Rowan Bramble.
main.quote: The forest is friendly once you learn which noises are squirrels and which are paperwork.

main.title: The Shed Must Go On
main.detail: Build a ranger's shed and a well so the forest patrol has supplies and fewer excuses.
main.quote: A proper outpost needs water, storage, and one drawer nobody opens.

main.title: Grain Expectations
main.short: Meet Bunty and start the wheat crop
main.detail: Meet Bunty Butterworth, harvest wheat, and weave linen for the settlement's awnings.
main.quote: A village without a bakery is merely a collection of hungry houses.

main.title: Stew Much Information
main.detail: Forage mushrooms around Rowan's shed and cook three pots of forest stew.
main.quote: Earthy, hearty, and legally distinguishable from a puddle.

main.title: Between a Rock and a Useful Place
main.detail: Explore Coppercrag Quarry, meet Ember Flint, and gather clay for the new works.
main.quote: Every boulder contains potential. Also more boulder.

main.title: Getting Fired Up
main.short: Build a kiln and fire bricks
main.detail: Build a potter's kiln and fire thirty bricks for the settlement's workshops.
main.quote: A kiln is an oven with ambition and fewer biscuits.

main.title: Forge Ahead
main.detail: Use the first brickworks to build a copper forge at the quarry.
main.quote: Strike while the iron is hot. If it complains, wear thicker gloves.

main.title: Heavy Metal
main.detail: Gather ore and forge fourteen sturdy ingots for the machines ahead.
main.quote: I call this song Hammer in D Minor. The anvil calls it Tuesday.

main.title: Core Values
main.detail: Visit Tumbledown Orchard, meet Professor Petal, and gather apples for preserving.
main.quote: One bad apple is a proverb. Seventy-two good apples are inventory.

main.title: Jam Session
main.detail: Preserve eighteen jars of orchard jam for market shelves and the eventual festival feast.
main.quote: Summer in a jar, assuming nobody loses the lid.

main.title: Commerce in the Wind
main.detail: Open a village market, then build a windmill where the island breeze can find it.
main.quote: Commerce begins when someone says, 'I made too much jam.'

main.title: Pumpkin to Talk About
main.detail: Expand the fields with sixty pumpkins and sixty lavender sprigs for food, bees, glass, and bunting.
main.quote: Orange for appetite. Purple for elegance. Mud for authenticity.

main.title: Flour Power
main.detail: Turn the wheat harvest into forty sacks of flour for the island's ambitious pie forecast.
main.quote: The secret ingredient is flour. The other secret ingredient is also flour.

main.title: Reel Introductions
main.detail: Visit Silverfin Marsh, meet Captain Minnow, and catch eighteen fish for future feasts.
main.quote: The fish are clever today. Yesterday too. I am detecting a pattern.

main.title: Poultry in Motion
main.short: Build a coop and collect eggs
main.detail: Build a chicken coop, keep it fed, and collect twenty eggs for the bakery.
main.quote: Never count your chickens before breakfast. It makes them nervous.

main.title: Hive Expectations
main.detail: Build an apiary near the lavender fields. Approach calmly and keep the puns tasteful.
main.quote: The bees run a tight operation. Their meetings have excellent buzz.

main.title: Pane and Gain
main.short: Gather honey and build a greenhouse
main.detail: Collect twenty-six honey, then build the iron-framed greenhouse Professor Petal designed.
main.quote: It is a house for plants. They remain terrible at paying rent.

main.title: Bridge Over Mildly Troubled Water
main.detail: Use planks, bricks, and ingots to restore the bridge into Starfall Highlands.
main.quote: I volunteer to supervise from this extremely safe side of the river.

main.title: Easy as Pie, Allegedly
main.detail: Bake twenty harvest pies: twelve for six feasts and eight for the festival table.
main.quote: The first slice is quality control. The second is a second opinion.

main.title: A Star Is Bored
main.detail: Cross the repaired bridge, explore Starfall Highlands, and meet astronomer Dr. Puddlewick.
main.quote: The universe is vast, ancient, and surprisingly bad at keeping appointments.

main.title: Through a Glass Brightly
main.detail: Forge eighteen panes of starglass for the gate, observatory frame, and Starfall Lens.
main.quote: Polish carefully. Fingerprints make the constellations look judgmental.

main.title: Four Relics, No Refunds
main.detail: Recover the four lost relics from the forest, quarry, orchard, and marsh.
main.quote: History belongs in a museum. These belong in four very sturdy pockets.

main.title: A Very Old Door
main.detail: Return all four relics and the required starglass and ingots to the ancient gate.
main.quote: The gate predates the town charter, which explains its sensible opening hours.

main.title: Room with a View
main.detail: Build the Starfall Observatory beyond the ancient gate.
main.quote: At last, a proper home for my telescope and emergency cocoa.

main.title: The Stars Come Home
main.detail: Complete the observatory's community lens and return the island's night sky to focus.
main.quote: There they are. Billions of stars, all refusing to explain the geese.

main.title: The Honking Hearth
main.detail: Build a tavern where every resident can trade stories, supper, and unreliable directions.
main.quote: A tavern is a town hall with pie and better minutes.

main.title: Six Courses of Action
main.detail: Use the tavern kitchen to prepare six feasts from pies, fish, jam, and bread.
main.quote: A feast is dinner with witnesses and significantly more pie.

main.title: Raise the Roof
main.detail: Build a pavilion beside Bramblewick for music, dancing, and mayoral announcements of uncertain length.
main.quote: A stage big enough for my ego? Ambitious, but proceed.

main.title: Bunting, Set, Go
main.detail: Weave twenty linen and place four lengths of rustic fence to guide the celebratory stampede.
main.quote: Bunting is cloth that has decided to become cheerful.

main.title: Moss, Mischief, and Moonlight
main.detail: Stock the pavilion and begin the celebration that brings every trail, trade, and friend together.
main.quote: By mayoral decree: tonight, even the geese must dance responsibly.

contracts.title: Signs of Progress
contracts.description: Rowan needs trail markers. Apparently 'probably this way' tested poorly.

contracts.title: Camp, Set, Match
contracts.description: Bundle patrol supplies for Rowan and one suspiciously pampered squirrel.

contracts.title: Bait Expectations
contracts.description: Captain Minnow is trading for bait. The fish have formed a tasting committee.

contracts.title: The Daily Catchphrase
contracts.description: Bring a fresh catch before Minnow invents another fish pun.

contracts.title: Ore Else
contracts.description: Ember needs quarry materials and an impractical amount of confidence.

contracts.title: Another Brick Request
contracts.description: Supply bricks for repairs nobody remembers approving.

contracts.title: Overdue Blooms
contracts.description: Professor Petal's seed library accepts returns and sincere apologies.

contracts.title: A Tonic Relationship
contracts.description: Mix supplies for plants described as droopy but brave.

contracts.title: The Yolk's on Bunty
contracts.description: Fill a breakfast basket before Mayor Honk declares crackers a meal.

contracts.title: Piece Offering
contracts.description: Restock the pie counter. Bunty counted the empty plates as evidence.

contracts.title: A Clear Night's Work
contracts.description: Puddlewick needs linen and starglass for a telescope that sees everything except dust.

contracts.title: Official Leftover Inspection
contracts.description: The mayor requires a modest civic snack for administrative purposes.
